$comment: The one table of an authored zone's checks (ENG-08 deliverable 2): the Registry's (ZONE_CHUNK and the other records' writes, ZoneAssert in contracts/persistent/src/systems/registry.cairo, ENG-09), the content pipeline's (the converter only: no record holds them alone) and the export's own. Ids R-n and E-n follow CLI-09 §5 where it has them. Each registry case runs through both sides: contracts/persistent/tests/test_zone.cairo's test_refuse_<case> (snforge, should_panic with the code) and tools/map-format/tests/test_convert.py (the converter refuses with the same code); test_convert.py also checks that each Cairo test exists with that code. R-38 is dropped (ADR-0008 rule 5, D-227): the registry ids go from R-37 to R-39.

registry.rule: The chunk set lies within the width × height rectangle (ENG-R1c bound 1, reused)
registry.mutation: the chunk set gains chunk 3, beyond the 3-chunk width

registry.rule: A quota's count is at most the zone's members (ENG-R1c bound 2, reused)
registry.mutation: quota 0's count 6, above the 5 chunks

registry.rule: For an authored zone, a quota's count is at most its candidates (bound 2, authored form; ruling 3)
registry.mutation: quota 0's count 3, above its 2 candidates

registry.rule: Spawn points, objects and candidate tiles on walkable tiles
registry.mutation: chunk 1's first spawn point on its first wall tile

registry.rule: Spawn points, objects and candidate tiles in the interior (rows and columns 1 to 13): a pack's goblins stand within 2 of its tile (Placement::near's precondition, ENG-09)
registry.mutation: chunk 1's spawn point on a floor tile of its ring

registry.rule: An object of a kind an authored chunk holds (chest, node, terrain trap, landmark, lever), untouched
registry.mutation: chunk 0's landmark made a vein (a quota's kind)

registry.code: zone chunk: empty with a value
registry.rule: An empty entry is all zeros; a candidate tile 0 where CANDIDATES does not name the chunk
registry.mutation: chunk 0 given a tile for quota 1, of which it is no candidate

registry.rule: No two placements (spawn points, objects, candidate tiles) on one tile
registry.mutation: chunk 2's chest moved onto its spawn point's tile

registry.rule: Within E-3 with every candidate counted: an object quota's against 3 objects, a Heart's against 2 packs
registry.mutation: chunk 2 given two more chests on its first two free floor tiles (4 objects with the vein's candidate)

registry.rule: Every gate anchor on a walkable tile
registry.mutation: gate 3's anchor moved to chunk 16's first wall tile

registry.rule: Every tile outside a border chunk's mask is a wall (ruling 6)
registry.mutation: chunk 2's tile 14 (column 14, outside its mask) made floor

registry.code: zone: chunk not in the set
registry.rule: A ZONE_CHUNK's chunk is in the zone's chunk set
registry.mutation: chunk 0 taken out of the chunk set

registry.rule: The anchor chunk names the gate among the two it anchors (the registry's gate index, #348's deferred item)
registry.mutation: chunk 16's gates cleared

registry.rule: The entry tile walkable
registry.mutation: the entry tile moved to chunk 0's first wall tile

registry.rule: An authored zone's level band at most 255 levels: a chunk's level is drawn with a byte's bound (audit t-0131)
registry.mutation: the band 0 to 255

registry.rule: A CANDIDATES write re-runs R-13 (and R-12, R-27, R-29, R-30) against the zone's QUOTAS (review t-0084, minor 1)
registry.mutation: quota 0's count 2 written over its two candidates, then its candidates rewritten to chunk 16 alone

registry.code: zone chunk: empty with a value
registry.rule: A CANDIDATES write re-runs R-14 and R-15 against each chunk whose candidacy changed
registry.mutation: quota 0's candidates rewritten without chunk 1, whose record keeps its candidate tile

registry.reads: a count of the Heart quotas naming the template (ENG-09, as caste_skills)
registry.rule: A PACK write that a Heart quota names re-runs R-27
registry.mutation: the raiders rewritten with every minimum 0 while quota 2, a Heart, names them

registry.rule: A Heart's template exists, at least 1 at its fewest and at its most (ENG-R1c bound 3, extended)
registry.mutation: quota 2's template has every minimum 0

registry.rule: A dungeon floor's width × height above N (ENG-R1c bound 4; dungeons only)
registry.mutation: the location made a dungeon floor of N 6 in its 3 × 2 rectangle

registry.rule: An authored zone's quotas place no exit and no set piece
registry.mutation: quota 1 made an exit

registry.rule: The location's quotas draw at most 640 times together at entry, min(count, members − count) a quota (D-220: with the eight task quotas the worst plan measures 95,799,175 L2 gas, under 100,000,000)
registry.mutation: a 15 × 15 zone whose six quotas (three object quotas, two Hearts, a landmark) take 112 of 225 candidates each: 672 draws

registry.rule: Every candidate chunk in the zone
registry.mutation: quota 0's candidates gain chunk 3

registry.rule: A bridge has a deck (a one-tile deck is valid, D-217)
registry.mutation: the bridge's deck emptied

registry.rule: Two distinct ends, below 225, off the deck
registry.mutation: the bridge's second end equal to its first

registry.rule: Each end walkable
registry.mutation: the bridge's first end on chunk 15's first wall tile

registry.code: bridge: end not by the deck
registry.rule: Each end next to a deck tile
registry.mutation: the bridge's first end on chunk 15's first floor tile

registry.rule: Every deck tile walkable in its chunk's plane (R-34 extended, ADR-0008 rule 1: a deck is floor)
registry.mutation: chunk 15's plane given its bridge's deck as wall

registry.checked_at: BRIDGE, ZONE_CHUNK, GATE, LOCATION (each against the other)
registry.rule: No spawn point, object, candidate tile, gate anchor or entry on a bridge's deck or ends (ADR-0008 rule 5)
registry.mutation: a chest on chunk 15's bridge's first end

registry.rule: A BRIDGE's index below its chunk's bridge count
registry.mutation: the bridge checked as index 1 of a chunk holding 1

pipeline.rule: Every walkable tile of the zone reachable from its entry (gate anchors, candidates and spawn points with them)
pipeline.mutation: a floor tile walled in by its six neighbours

pipeline.rule: The records, re-assembled across their seams with the rows' parity, give the painted walkable plane back
pipeline.mutation: a wall bit of chunk 1's records flipped on its seam with chunk 0

pipeline.rule: A bridge's deck is one connected piece
pipeline.mutation: a deck of two tiles that do not touch

export.rule: The origin's row is even (D-216)

export.code: export: door not on the border
export.rule: A building's door is a hex of its footprint's border (CLI-09e §4)
A prop, building, NPC or bridge kind of kinds.json

export.code: export: two candidates in a chunk
export.rule: At most one candidate of a quota in a chunk (the layout holds one tile a quota)

export.code: export: three gates in a chunk
export.rule: At most two gates anchored in a chunk (the layout holds two ids)
Format 1: a bridge (deck and ends) lies in one chunk
A deck tile inside the zone (ADR-0008 rule 1)
A deck tile on no building's footprint and no blocking prop (ADR-0008 rule 1)
A building's footprint, authored per building, lies in the zone
A building's footprint is one connected piece
A building's door stands on painted walkable ground

export.code: export: gate not on the outline
export.rule: A gate to another location anchors on the outline (a zone hex with a neighbour outside the zone); a dungeon's entrance (its destination LOCATION a dungeon, the manifest's location_kinds) may stand inside the chunk set
The file matches schema.json (fields, types, ranges, anchored patterns)
Every painted hex, moved by the origin, lies within [0, 15 width) × [0, 15 height) (D-216)
A row's ground and outline, when given, are as long as its terrain
A zone gives location, region, biome, level_min, level_max and entry; a town or an outpost its location and region
Every name (location, region, gate, pack, collector, landmark, skill, spawn table, set piece) is in the content manifest (R-17's existence, OPS-01)
A candidate names a quota of the map's list

export.code: zone: chunk not in the set
export.rule: A spawn point, feature, candidate, gate or bridge lies in a chunk of the zone
A set piece is one chunk (1 × 1)
A set piece keeps D-134's corners (SetPieceAssert; ruling 5 lifts them for authored zone chunks only)
A set piece's packs and objects on its interior floor (SetPieceAssert)
A set piece holds at most 2 packs and 3 objects (its layout, E-3)
Anything else the converter cannot read: a refusal line, never a traceback
`format` is `grimworld-export`
`version` is one this converter reads (1); a newer one is refused (the versioning rule of schema.json)
A manifest id (and a gate's quest) is not negative: the field it is packed into holds an unsigned integer. Refused before any record is packed
A manifest id packed into a 16-bit field (region, location, gate, pack, collector, landmark, skill, spawn table) is at most 65535; 65535 converts, 65536 is refused
A set piece's id and a gate's quest (Gate.quest: u32) are at most 4294967295; 4294967295 converts, 4294967296 is refused
